observations.finding: The CUDA run emitted PyTorch warnings that CuBLAS operations were not deterministic because CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG was unset.
observations.impact: Fixed-seed reproducibility was not established; all v1 model outcomes are ineligible for M5 promotion.

observations.finding: The second Qlib Recorder run listed all three artifacts, but default-path download of candidate_receipt.json failed.
observations.impact: The terminal run manifest was not published and the required Recorder readback gate failed.

repair_scope: Set and verify CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 before importing torch.
Use strict deterministic algorithms instead of warn-only mode.
Download each Recorder artifact into a run-unique temporary directory.
Add one counted B1 wf_2018 refit and require exact score equality.
prohibited_use: Do not use v1 metrics, predictions or checkpoints for model selection.
Do not reinterpret completed fold receipts as an M5 pass.
